title: a tin lantern
examine: A dented tin lantern with a horn window, its wick trimmed short. It smells of fish oil.
birth: the market sells lanterns: the market runner births an item cell per sale (init.item.json with OWNER = the buyer, WHERE = 0) and pays the create tariff from A_mkt; law.management ; law.item
note: the dark clause (law.sheet 18) needs kind = {LANTERN} = 2, owner = the mover and charges > 0; the referee spends one charge per tick the lantern's holder is in a dark room (clause 4 of law.item lets it)
